bucket_definition_source.note: 75 pilot bucket classifier logic is reused from select_vri_translation_samples.py; 75 artifact is used only for compatibility validation, not as value source for new segments.

hard_bucket_detection_rules.abhidhamma_definition: abhidhamma source plus katamo/katame/katamā/katamaṃ, or at least two of lakkhaṇa/rasa/paccupaṭṭhāna/padaṭṭhāna; vuttaṃ/vuccati/ti/nāma/attho alone do not trigger
hard_bucket_detection_rules.citation_heavy: source_text contains one or more citation markers: ['dī. ni.', 'ma. ni.', 'saṃ. ni.', 'aṅ. ni.', 'khu. pā.', 'dha. pa.', 'udā.', 'itivu.', 'jā.', 'mahāva.', 'cūḷava.', 'visuddhi.', 'aṭṭha.', 'ṭī.', 'abhidhamma']
hard_bucket_detection_rules.commentarial_discussion: atthakatha/tika plus strong discussion markers; long alone does not trigger
hard_bucket_detection_rules.glossary_risk: controlled glossary term is context_variant/needs_human/cross_avoid, or fixed with avoid_ko
hard_bucket_detection_rules.long_compound_or_dense_prose: long prose with high average token length or low punctuation dense prose
